changes.to: Ghost Robotics' own technical specifications on the Vision 60 page: 51 kg tare, 950 x 570 x 685 mm standing (250 mm body width, 419 mm ride height), 10 kg payload, standard walk 0.9 m/s with 1.2 m/s fast-walk and 2.4 m/s sprint (target 3.0), 3.15 h continuous walking at 0.9 m/s or 21 h standby, IP67, -40 to 55 C, 4G/LTE and Wi-Fi with a GigE switch. The Jetson Xavier 32 GB / 2 TB NVMe compute entry comes from the maker's spec sheet v3.3.
